import React from 'react';
import { Grid, Paper, Typography, Divider, Box } from '@mui/material';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

const InfoRow = ({ label, value }) => (
  <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={4}>
    <Box sx={{ mb: 1.5 }}>
      <Typography variant="caption" color="textSecondary">{label}</Typography>
      <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={500}>{value || '—'}</Typography>
    </Box>
  </Grid>
);

const BasicInfoTab = ({ employee }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const e = employee || {};

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>{t('employees.personal_info')}</Typography>
      <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
      <Grid container spacing={1}>
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.first_name')} value={e.first_name} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.last_name')} value={e.last_name} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.national_id')} value={e.national_id} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.birth_date')} value={e.birth_date} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.birth_place')} value={e.birth_place} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.gender')} value={e.gender_display} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.marital_status')} value={e.marital_status_display} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.children_count')} value={e.children_count} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.spouse_name')} value={e.spouse_name} />
      </Grid>

      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 3 }}>{t('employees.identity_info')}</Typography>
      <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
      <Grid container spacing={1}>
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.national_id_serial')} value={e.national_id_serial} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.national_id_place')} value={e.national_id_place} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.national_id_date')} value={e.national_id_date} />
      </Grid>

      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 3 }}>{t('employees.contact_info')}</Typography>
      <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
      <Grid container spacing={1}>
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.phone')} value={e.phone} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.mobile')} value={e.mobile} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.email')} value={e.email} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.address')} value={e.address} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.postal_code')} value={e.postal_code} />
      </Grid>

      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom sx={{ mt: 3 }}>{t('employees.emergency_contact')}</Typography>
      <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
      <Grid container spacing={1}>
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.emergency_contact_name')} value={e.emergency_contact_name} />
        <InfoRow label={t('employees.emergency_contact_phone')} value={e.emergency_contact_phone} />
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default BasicInfoTab;
